mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dp_base.t_dp_base_node_map_post (map_code, node_code, post_codes, enterprise_code) VALUES (#{mapCode}, #{nodeCode}, #{postCodes}, #{enterpriseCode}) ON CONFLICT(node_code, enterprise_code) DO UPDATE SET post_codes = EXCLUDED.post_codes
mapper.select: SELECT node_code FROM dp_base.t_dp_base_node_map_post WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND post_codes LIKE '%' || #{postCodeValue} || '%' AND delete_flag = false
